question: In a certain code language, ‘REFINE’ is written as ‘KHOZKL’. How will ‘SOLVENT’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**Logic : (6) is added and subtracted alternately from the position value of each letter, starting with adding (+6) to the last letter of the word. Then reversed.**

So,

 
• REFINE is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6bc9e039d28ecfe069b5c8ecf88f311781d378e16849c1cf4971da755a5b9d1.png] 

Similarly,

 
• SOLVENT is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d815e7b449b0d138c05702658a3c451c9b668ecaa12a4b60bb8889f5ee485ea7.png] ​

Hence, **"****ZHKPRIY"** is the correct answer.
